convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for BalanceOfPower_Histogram custom indicator and external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh, SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) for trading logic and smoothing algorithms. Custom indicator must be replicated in Python.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before EA starts trading
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds for signal timing

other_exits: Buy closed when histogram Value[1]>Value[2] (bearish divergence) and BuyPosClose enabled; Sell closed when histogram Value[1]<Value[2] (bullish divergence) and SellPosClose enabled

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode=LOT uses fixed lot size (MM=0.1); other modes use MM as percentage fraction of balance/free margin for lot calculation

custom_logic_notes: Entry requires a two-bar divergence pattern: Value[1]<Value[2] (bullish histogram declining) triggers buy side when Value[0]>Value[1] (current bar reverses up); Value[1]>Value[2] (bearish histogram rising) triggers sell side when Value[0]<Value[1] (current bar reverses down). This is a momentum reversal strategy on the BalanceOfPower histogram. When SignalBar=0, the EA evaluates on every tick instead of only on new bars. Signal times are calculated as last bar date plus TimeShiftSec for order expiration/timing.
python_conversion_notes: Must replicate BalanceOfPower_Histogram custom indicator logic in Python. The indicator uses T3 smoothing (MODE_T3=8) with length=15 and phase=15 by default. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose wrapper functions which handle order placement, position checking, and money management - these must be reimplemented. SmoothAlgorithms.mqh provides the CJJMA and other smoothing classes - the T3 smoothing implementation must be ported. The entry logic reads 3 consecutive buffer values (bars SignalBar, SignalBar+1, SignalBar+2) and checks for a reversal pattern: histogram declining then upticking for buys, histogram rising then downticking for sells.
